metric: Missing rate per input vs baseline
amber: +5 percentage points or >2% of values outside baseline range
red: +10 percentage points or a field entirely blank
first action: Find the cause (system change / vendor / form); fix the feed before touching the model

metric: PSI of score vs development (5 bins)
first action: Check which inputs moved (CSI); confirm whether the applicant mix really changed
Check whether the model was built on applicants like the new ones; note any new channel or product

amber: Change of 5 percentage points or more
red: Change of 10 percentage points or more
first action: Explain the change (policy / mix / data); if unexplained treat as a data alert

metric: Override rate (manual decisions against the model)
amber: Above 10% or doubled vs trailing 6 months
first action: Review a sample of overrides; are lenders compensating for something the model misses?

metric: Actual / expected 30+ DPD at 6 months on book
first action: Segment the cohort (channel / industry / geography / booking month); report to credit committee

metric: AUC of matured cohort vs development
cadence: Annually or when a cohort reaches 12 months on book
amber: Drop > 0.03 and development AUC outside cohort 95% interval
first action: Check by segment; if rank order degraded plan a rebuild

metric: Actual / expected defaults (overall and by PD band)
cadence: Annually or when a cohort reaches 12 months on book
first action: If rank order is fine recalibrate; if not rebuild
Run the input-level proxy review; document

metric: Correlation of each input with estimated group membership
cadence: Annually and whenever an input is added or changed
first action: Document business justification; test a less discriminatory alternative

amber: Any change to inputs or methodology
red: Change without notice or without documentation
first action: Re-run stability checks on the next month of scores; request documentation
